questions.stem: Drug of choice for treating cutaneous larva migrans, or “creeping eruption is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Oral albendazole

Oral albendazole is an antiparasitic medicine, used for the treatment of parasitic worm infections. It works by killing the worms that cause infections and stops the infection from spreading.
